claim_ceiling: Candidate request only; no Lab type admission, operational decision, media receipt or participant authority.

compatibility_analysis.rejection_reason: An Operational Observation is an attributable datum; a resumable upload needs an idempotent transfer state machine, part lineage and completion/abort invariants.

expiry.condition: Resolved, rejected or superseded after exact semantic and Artifact Type owner review.

validation_purpose: Validate one resumable private media transfer with part receipts, source digest, session pin and final verification state, without equating upload with accepted response.
